name: Sargeron Smite generates 20 Energy on hit (#5165)
contract: Sargeron Smite (802060, rank 2 = 501314) tooltip reads 'Blast an enemy for ... Shadowflame Damage and generate $521213s1 Energy', where 521213 (Energize +20 energy) is SPELL_EFFECT_ENERGIZE, EffectMiscValue POWER_ENERGY, EffectBasePoints 19 + DieSides 1 = 20. Neither rank's own DBC effects reference 521213 directly (rank 2's stray Effect[2] SPELL_EFFECT_DUMMY carries TriggerSpell 706658, an unrelated spell that a dummy effect never auto-fires natively anyway), and no CoA script cast 521213 anywhere - the energize half of the tooltip had no implementation at all. The fix adds an unconditional Cast(player, player, 521213) in felsworn_casts::OnSpellHitResult, gated the same way as every other Named(info, 802060) hit-result branch (successful hit, hostile, non-self target), matching the tooltip's unqualified 'generate 20 Energy' (only the free-second-cast half is Inner Demon-gated per the DBC description text).

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: energy is at the fixtured value
DISCRIMINATING: the hit generates exactly the DBC's 20 Energy (BasePoints 19 + DieSides 1), with a small normal regeneration allowance
